summary: Your eighth teach-back. You answer a colleague who is happy with numpy, explain why vectors live in a database with one fair case where it is not needed, check six key points, and measure exact against HNSW-indexed search on 50,000 synthetic vectors: much faster, almost the same answers, and a build cost.
goal: Explain in 5 sentences why vectors live in a database, with the speed, accuracy and cost of an index measured.

items.text: Write what you would answer the colleague and one situation where they are right
Explain why we use a vector database, with a fair case where it is not needed, in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Run scale_test.py and read the speed, the plan and the recall
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap and add the fair case
Play the Why a Vector Database game to the end and see your score
